title: 15 FREE Things You Can Get with Your LA Public Library Card
description:
Did you know your Los Angeles Public Library card can unlock hundreds—even thousands—of dollars' worth of free resources?

Here are 15 FREE resources and services you need to know about—and they're probably not what you think. From free museum passes, Wi-Fi, laptops, and 3D printers to recording studios, Adobe Creative Cloud, tutoring, legal assistance, California State Park passes, eBooks, movies, career and learning tools, a free online high school diploma program, family events, and many other valuable community services, there's something for everyone.

Free resources and services are subject to availability, eligibility, and Los Angeles Public Library borrowing policies. Some items require reservations, the checkout of library equipment or materials, or use at participating library locations.

To learn more and explore everything the Los Angeles Public Library has to offer, visit LAPL.org and discover for yourself why the Los Angeles Public Library card is the best card in L.A.
